lines: Good evening. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

Canada’s envoy to the European Union says Brussels removed language about ratifying the decade-old trade deal from a joint statement issued at the end of the summit in Montreal last week, The Canadian Press reports.
Trump signs proclamation he says will prevent future changes to the Oval Office and Cabinet Room, The Associated Press reports.

Nithya Raman’s upstart campaign marked a generational shift at City Hall as voters followed the lead of New York, where democratic socialist Zohran Mamdani was elected last year, The Associated Press reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
